<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><A NAME="toc165525_1"></A>EXPLANATORY NOTE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Amendment No.&nbsp;4 to Form&nbsp;10 (this &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) amends the Registration Statement on Form&nbsp;10 of SLR Secured Specialty Lending
Fund as first filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) on July&nbsp;14, 2026 and as amended by Amendment No.&nbsp;1 to Form&nbsp;10 filed with the SEC on August&nbsp;11, 2026, and by Amendment No.&nbsp;2 to Form&nbsp;10
filed with the SEC on August&nbsp;13, 2026 and by Amendment No. 3 to Form 10 filed with the SEC on October 11, 2026 (as so amended, the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;). This Amendment is being filed to include an unaudited schedule of the
investments SLR Secured Specialty Lending Fund (the &#8220;Fund&#8221;) acquired as part of its Initial Portfolio Investments. In accordance with Rule 12b-15 under the Exchange Act, this Amendment No. 4 amends only Item 15 of Form 10. No other
changes were made to the Registration Statement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Registration Statement became effective automatically sixty days after it was initially filed with
the SEC, and the Fund is currently subject to the reporting and other requirements of the Exchange Act and the rules promulgated thereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This
Amendment No. 4 should be read in conjunction with the prior filings and any subsequent filings of the Fund with the SEC. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><A NAME="toc165525_18"></A>ITEM&#8201;15. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND EXHIBITS. </B></P>

financial statements included in this Registration Statement are listed &#8220;Item 13. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
